correctness.rationale: Eight vectors (two square latitude rings) have vanishing odd moments through degree three and mean second moment I_3/3. Positive equal normal weights and spanning set satisfy discrete Minkowski existence for a polytope of facet areas π/2. Cauchy projected-area formula identifies ΠP with the zonotope sum[-πu/4,πu/4]; determinant volume formula is π³/8 times 56 unordered absolute 3×3 minors. The complete classification by 8 same-ring, 16 opposite-pair and 32 adjacent-pair minors gives unscaled sum 32(1+cos d+sin d), hence vol=8π³/(3√3)(1+cos d+sin d). On d∈[0,π/4], cos d+sin d strictly increases, yielding all extremizers modulo square relabeling/reflection. Independently recomputed 56 minors and QHull volumes of all 256 endpoint sums at 0,.1,.34,π/4; results matched to floating precision. These checks are corroboration; closed symbolic partition proves all twists.
